why: label-keyed transition lookup. The label mapping does exist here -- `from_msg_transition_label` in `nros-node/src/lifecycle_services.rs` resolves the label a `ChangeState` request carries, including the generic `"shutdown"` -- but only inside the service layer, where a label actually arrives on the wire. A C caller has `RCLC_LIFECYCLE_TRANSITION_*` constants and needs no string compare.
